characters.name: Ben
characters.description: A resourceful traveler who takes charge of barricading the farmhouse against the ghouls outside.

characters.name: Barbara
characters.description: A young woman traumatized after witnessing her brother's death at the cemetery, retreating into shock as the night worsens.

characters.name: Harry Cooper
characters.description: A gruff, self-interested father hiding in the cellar with his family, who clashes with Ben over how to survive the night.

characters.name: Helen Cooper
characters.description: Harry's wife, more level-headed than her husband, torn between loyalty to him and doing what's reasonable for the group.

characters.name: Tom
characters.description: A young man dating Judy who volunteers to help siphon gas for an escape attempt.

characters.name: Judy
characters.description: Tom's girlfriend, reluctant to be separated from him during the escape attempt.

characters.name: Karen Cooper
characters.description: Harry and Helen's daughter, bitten earlier in the night and steadily growing worse in the cellar.
